question: Are teacher/student saved support-mode differences consistent enough across load thresholds to justify a contact timing constraint?
initial_mode: Accept the saved anchor label without claiming a prior dwell history
confirmation: A changed label is emitted only at the current sample after consecutive evidence; candidate onset is retrospective metadata, not the emission time
pending_tail: Preserve an unconfirmed final candidate; never use a future or terminating sample to complete it
single_sample_excursions: Retrospective A-B-A label statistic with both neighbors observed; never a causal classifier input
source_scope: Eight dependent anchors from four explored train/validation clips; no new held-out data
